lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਊਤਮ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan sresat ootam isanaan ||
lines.translation: The most sublime wisdom and purifying baths;

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath kamal pragaas ||
lines.translation: the four cardinal blessings, the opening of the heart-lotus;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੈ ਮਧਿ ਸਗਲ ਤੇ ਉਦਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kai madh sagal te udaas ||
lines.translation: in the midst of all, and yet detached from all;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰੁ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਤਤ ਕਾ ਬੇਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar chatur tat kaa betaa ||
lines.translation: beauty, intelligence, and the realization of reality;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੇਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: samadarasee ek drisatetaa ||
lines.translation: to look impartially upon all, and to see only the One

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਫਲ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih phal tis jan kai mukh bhane ||
lines.translation: - these blessings come to one who,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਚਨ ਮਨਿ ਸੁਨੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak naam bachan man sune ||6||
lines.translation: through Guru Nanak, chants the Naam with his mouth, and hears the Word with his ears. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪੈ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu nidhaan japai man koi ||
lines.translation: One who chants this treasure in his mind

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jug mahi taa kee gat hoi ||
lines.translation: in every age, he attains salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਮ ਧੁਨਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gobi(n)d naam dhun baanee ||
lines.translation: In it is the Glory of God, the Naam, the chanting of Gurbani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਬਖਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: simrit saasatr bed bakhaanee ||
lines.translation: The Simritees, the Shaastras and the Vedas speak of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਤਾਂਤ ਕੇਵਲ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal mataa(n)t keval har naam ||
lines.translation: The essence of all religion is the Lord's Name alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d bhagat kai man bisraam ||
lines.translation: It abides in the minds of the devotees of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਅਪ੍ਰਾਧ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot apraadh saadhasa(n)g mitai ||
lines.translation: Millions of sins are erased, in the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t kripaa te jam te chhutai ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of the Saint, one escapes the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai masatak karam prabh paae ||
lines.translation: Those, who have such pre-ordained destiny on their foreheads,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਆਏ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: saadh saran naanak te aae ||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, enter the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis man basai sunai laai preet ||
lines.translation: One, within whose mind it abides, and who listens to it with love

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis jan aavai har prabh cheet ||
lines.translation: that humble person consciously remembers the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran taa kaa dookh nivaarai ||
lines.translation: The pains of birth and death are removed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਦੇਹ ਤਤਕਾਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dulabh deh tatakaal udhaarai ||
lines.translation: The human body, so difficult to obtain, is instantly redeemed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਭਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal sobhaa a(n)mrit taa kee baanee ||
lines.translation: Spotlessly pure is his reputation, and ambrosial is his speech.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ek naam man maahi samaanee ||
lines.translation: The One Name permeates his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh rog binase bhai bharam ||
lines.translation: Sorrow, sickness, fear and doubt depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh naam niramal taa ke karam ||
lines.translation: He is called a Holy person; his actions are immaculate and pure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh te ooch taa kee sobhaa banee ||
lines.translation: His glory becomes the highest of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਗੁਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਮਨੀ ॥੮॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ih gun naam sukhamanee ||8||24||
lines.translation: O Nanak, by these Glorious Virtues, this is named Sukhmani, Peace of mind. ||8||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਤੀ ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: thitee gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: T'hitee ~ The Lunar Days: Gauree, Fifth Mehl,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਿਆ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal pooriaa suaamee sirajanahaar ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord and Master is pervading the water, the land, and the sky.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik bhaa(n)t hoi pasariaa naanak eka(n)kaar ||1||
lines.translation: In so many ways, the One, the Universal Creator has diffused Himself, O Nanak. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਮ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekam eka(n)kaar prabh karau ba(n)danaa dhiaai ||
lines.translation: The first day of the lunar cycle: Bow in humility and meditate on the One, the Universal Creator Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gobi(n)d gupaal prabh saran parau har raai ||
lines.translation: Praise God, the Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World; seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸੁਖ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee aas kaliaan sukh jaa te sabh kachh hoi ||
lines.translation: Place your hopes in Him, for salvation and peace; all things come from Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaar ku(n)t dah dis bhramio tis bin avar na koi ||
lines.translation: I wandered around the four corners of the world and in the ten directions, but I saw nothing except Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸੁਨੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bed puraan simrit sune bahu bidh karau beechaar ||
lines.translation: I listened to the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, and I pondered over them in so many ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit udhaaran bhai haran sukh saagar nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The Saving Grace of sinners, the Destroyer of fear, the Ocean of peace, the Formless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਾ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਦੇਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daataa bhugataa denahaar tis bin avar na jaai ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver, the Enjoyer, the Bestower - there is no place at all without Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo chaahahi soee milai naanak har gun gaai ||1||
lines.translation: You shall obtain all that you desire, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d jas gaaeeai har neet ||
lines.translation: Sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, each and every day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਭਜੀਐ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil bhajeeai saadhasa(n)g mere meet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and vibrate, meditate on Him, O my friend. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਉ ਬੰਦਨਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: karau ba(n)danaa anik vaar saran parau har raai ||
lines.translation: Bow in humility to the Lord, over and over again, and enter the Sanctuary of the Lord, our King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhram kateeai naanak saadhasa(n)g duteeaa bhaau mitaai ||2||
lines.translation: Doubt is eradicated, O Nanak, in the Company of the Holy, and the love of duality is eliminated. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਤੀਆ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਨੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: duteeaa duramat door kar gur sevaa kar neet ||
lines.translation: The second day of the lunar cycle: Get rid of your evil-mindedness, and serve the Guru continually.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਬਸੈ ਤਜਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam ratan man tan basai taj kaam krodh lobh meet ||
lines.translation: The jewel of the Lord's Name shall come to dwell in your mind and body, when you renounce sexual desire, anger and greed, O my friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਬਿਨਸਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: maran mitai jeevan milai binasahi sagal kales ||
lines.translation: Conquer death and obtain eternal life; all your troubles will depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਰਵੇਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tajahu gobi(n)d bhajahu bhaau bhagat paraves ||
lines.translation: Renounce your self-conceit and vibrate upon the Lord of the Universe; loving devotion to Him shall permeate your being.
